definition: The cards you bring to play with. In Standard, a deck has at least 60 cards.
In Magic's story, you, the player, are a planeswalker: a powerful wizard. There's also a card type with the same name, which you'll meet later.
A card you're casting. It becomes a spell while it waits to take effect. Lands are never spells: you play them, you don't cast them.
How much life a player has. Each player starts with 20 in a normal game. Damage lowers it. At 0 or less, that player loses.
Your deck, once the game has started. It sits face down, and you draw cards from the top of it.
A marker some cards give to a player. A player with 10 or more poison counters loses the game.
